text:
Mike: Kicking off the regional rollout wavefront now — US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC, canary plan 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pinning release to v2.1.3. @Sana @Alex @ops-oncall FYI.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy started: v2.1.3 pinned, slice=1/5, region=us-west, canary=2%. CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/1234 ✅

Sana: EU capacity check — cluster-eu-1 baseline 920 qps, current warm pool 2 nodes. Canary 2% ~= 80 qps, fine but heatmap shows spikes 750-900 at peak. Recommend warm +1 before EU canary.

Alex: Rollback/abort criteria we agreed: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets. Also customer-facing errors > 0.3% triggers pause.

Eva: Adding smoke test: run prompt/regen suite + long-context traces in EU after warm. I'll post results in 10m.

ops-oncall: Note: EU GPU pool current util 65%, memory fragmentation on rtx-90 nodes causing 1.8% evictions last 24h. If warm fails we should pin EU to v2.1.2 and route 30% traffic to US fallback.

Lucas: Suggest throttling policy for APAC ramp: linear ramp with 2m steps, max burst cap 200rps, fallback variant=quant-8 for low-priority slices.

Mike: Ack. Setting deploy bot holdpoints: after US 2% -> health check -> EU warm -> EU canary. If any holdpoint fails we autoswitch pin/route as ops recommended.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 2% in us-west. Health: 5xx=0.02%, p95=420ms, error rate stable. Proceeding to 10% in 10m unless hold issued.

Sana: Holding EU release until warm pool + smoke tests complete. Please pause the scheduled EU ramp.

Mike: Hold accepted, deploy-bot timer paused. @deploy-bot please set manual approval for EU slice.

deploy-bot: Timer paused. Manual approval required for region=eu-west-1.

Eva: Smoke tests (eu): prompt regressions: 0/120 failed. Long-context memory pass. Observed ephemeral latency spike at t+30s on one host, traced to GC during quant init. Mitigated by bumping warm pool by +1 node.

ops-oncall: After warm bump, EU GPU util 52%, evictions dropped to 0.2%. Ready to continue.

Mike: Okay moving EU to 2% canary now. Reminder: rollback triggers as stated. Posting release notes link to customers after 24h stable: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/20260319-v2.1.3

deploy-bot: EU canary deployed (2%). Health snapshot: 5xx=0.04%, p95=460ms, infra errors=0.01%. Scheduling 10% in 12m.

Alex: Quick confirm on routing if EU degrades: route 30% -> us-west, keep 70% local pinned to v2.1.2, and pause further ramps. Ops, can you automate that route rule?

ops-oncall: Yes, will push runbook step to traffic-router: if 5xx>0.5% for 5m then set route_map EU->US 30% and pin eu to v2.1.2. I'll make the change live-ready.

Lucas: APAC warmers — will start parallel warm pools but hold actual canary until EU completes 10% ok.

Mike: Agreed. No APAC canary until EU 10% stable for 15m.

deploy-bot: EU passed health gate at 10% (15m). Metrics: 5xx=0.03%, p95=480ms, throughput steady. Proceeding to 50% in 30m.

Sana: Noted. Please watch customer sessions originating from EU customers — we have a VIP customer on a call at 03:15 UTC. If any slowness, abort immediately.

Mike: Will watch. Ops-oncall on standby.

ops-oncall: Oncall monitoring enabled, alert thresholds tightened for this window. I will trigger the route fallback manually if anomalies show before automation kick-in.

Eva: Posting final checklist so PM can prep release notes: top-line perf improvements, quantization toggles, known issue (edge-case with long-chat where truncation occurs at 4096 tokens). Link: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/draft-v2.1.3

Mike: Thanks all. If no objections, continue with the wavefront and I will update the customer-facing note after 24h stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout wavefront continuing: US->EU completed canary stages, APAC warmers in progress. Current status: overall 10% global, no rollbacks.

Mike: End of thread — monitoring window open for 24h. If anyone sees signal > thresholds call the rollback channel and tag @ops-oncall.
